alerts.description:
* WHAT...Urban and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of western Texas, including the following
county, El Paso.

* WHEN...Until 645 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Some low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 450 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This will cause urban and small stream
flooding. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Additional rainfall of up to 0.5 inches is expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that may experience flooding include...
East El Paso, Far East El Paso, Mission Valley, Clint,
Horizon City, San Elizario, Socorro, Sparks and Colonia del
Paso.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
